scientific_integrity: New claims are a strict all-threshold concentration ordering and a Bernoulli-Laplace additive-noise factorization. Classical simplex-coordinate identities, order-statistic range laws, and symmetric-convex probability inequalities are explicitly credited. Historical generalized-logistic ordering coverage remains a bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric common Dirichlet parameters on the open simplex only; the Hilbert metric uses the full logarithmic cross-ratio. No claims for nonsymmetric sampling, arbitrary convex bodies, or invariant Hilbert volume. Numerical checks are not universal proofs.
title: Strict Dirichlet-concentration ordering of Hilbert distances in every simplex
